item.title: He Had to Audacity to Go On TV After What He Did!
item.description: When Lynsey Wilson met Mitchell Quy she wasn’t aware of how controlling and abusive he was going to be. Join me in my latest True Crime episode where I take a deep dive into a story that will shock you to the core.
